front.text: 今天和大家在一起，很高興，現在和大家說再見了。

back.text: Today I am very happy to be with everyone, and now I say goodbye to everyone.
back.notes:
Jīntiān hé dàjiā zài yīqǐ, hěn gāoxìng, xiànzài hé dàjiā shuō zàijiàn le.

「再見」(zàijiàn) 是漢語中常用的告別語，意為「goodbye」或「see you later」。在本句中，它作動詞「說」的賓語，構成「說再見」这一常見搭配，表示交談或聚會結束時的礼貌告别。

back.text: There are very few people here.
back.notes:
zhèlǐ de rén hěn shǎo

少 is an adjective meaning “few” or “little.” Here it follows 很 to describe a small number of people, functioning as the predicate adjective.

back.text: bǎ - measure word for objects with handles; particle
This piece of clothing is fifty yuan.
back.notes:
Zhè jiàn yīfu shì wǔshí kuài qián.

Measure word for a basic monetary unit; in 五十塊錢 it means 'yuan' after the number 五十.

back.text: yuè... yuè... - the more... the more...

back.notes:
Bàba jīntiān kāihuì.

此句中的「開」與「會」組成「開會」，表示舉行或參加會議。

back.text: zhī - measure word for certain animals/birds
